test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A lover of mankind
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'Philanthropist' is derived from the Greek words ***philos* (loving) and *anthropos* (man),** meaning someone who loves mankind and actively works to promote human welfare.
 
• The term** 'Philanthropy' **involves **charitable giving to human causes on a large scale, often involving the donation of money, resources, or time to improve the well-being of others.**
 
• Many well-known** philanthropists, such as Bill Gates and Warren Buffet**, have dedicated significant portions of their wealth to charitable causes.
 
 
• Example: Bill Gates is a renowned **philanthropist **who has contributed billions of dollars to global health and education initiatives.​
 
 

Hence, the correct sentence is: *A lover of mankind is known as a **Philanthropist***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Recluse** refers to someone who lives a solitary life and avoids people.
 
• **Cynic** is a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest.
 
• **Psychiatrist** is a medical practitioner specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of mental illness.
